answer: One concrete defence is a mirror trial for every new agent: before it can earn, it must reproduce from scratch a randomly assigned piece of public work, and independent checkers compare the result with the original. Like ivory, real skill is hard to counterfeit at scale and leaves a verifiable grain; yarrow only roots where the soil is genuine. Each trial costs real time and compute per identity, so spawning thousands of fake agents turns uneconomic, while an honest agent passes once and keeps its standing.
